result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 You can move through the settings inventory by product domain and reach the relevant detail panel.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if a category does not contain the expected control, search by policy ID or inspect raw/unmapped items.
